## Quick start

1. Mount the phone so the front camera sees your upper body, arms and at least part of your legs. 2. Let the app find the bar automatically, or use Line to set it manually. 3. Hang below the bar with your arms extended. 4. Pull up until the top position is reached. 5. Lower yourself again with your arms extended. A valid cycle adds one repetition.

## Bar calibration

Auto searches for the bar while you hang still. Stay fully in frame and avoid moving until BAR FOUND appears. Line switches to manual calibration: draw the line directly along the bar in the camera image. Manual mode is useful when the bar is hard to detect, the background is complex or lighting is poor.

## Main workout screen

The skeleton shows the pose detected by MediaPipe. The horizontal line is the calibrated bar. The large number is the current score. Tap the score area to cycle between Attempt / Today, Today and All time. New starts a new attempt without deleting previous history. The pencil edits the current attempt and lets you correct its repetition count.

## Pause

Tap an empty area of the camera screen to pause or continue. During pause pose processing, counting and TTS stop; the skeleton and bar disappear and a translucent pause symbol is shown. After continuing the bar is calibrated again. If you used automatic calibration, auto search restarts. If you used manual calibration, the app asks you to set the line again. While you are placing a manual bar, taps belong to calibration and do not trigger pause.

## Counting logic

A repetition is counted only after the app sees a valid lower position, movement upward, a valid upper position and the return downward. The lower position checks extended arms and body position relative to the bar. The upper position checks elbow angle and that the mouth/chin area has moved above the bar. The app also rejects poses that do not look like a real standing/hanging person, reducing false detections from the background.

## Voice

There are two independent voice switches. Count voice announces the displayed repetition count. Coaching voice gives short hints such as go lower, straighten your arms, go higher, bar found and you can start. Both are off by default when the app starts. The voice language follows the selected app language. If the required TTS voice is missing, Android or the installed TTS engine may ask you to download a voice package.

## History

History stores completed and current attempts with date and repetition count. The daily total and all-time total are calculated from saved attempts. You can open History from the main screen. Correcting the current attempt also updates daily and all-time totals.

## Settings

General contains Language and Theme. System language follows the phone when supported; otherwise the base English resources are used. Theme can be Dark, Light or System. The workout screen keeps the display awake while it is open.

## Pull-up parameters

Bottom arm angle controls how straight the arms must be in the lower position. Allowed range: 140–170°, default 150°. Top arm angle controls how bent the arms must be at the top. Allowed range: 65–100°, default 85°. Top hold delay controls how long the valid upper position must be maintained before the repetition is accepted. Allowed range: 100–1000 ms, default 250 ms. The reset icon appears only when a value differs from its default. Exit thresholds are calculated automatically to keep the detector stable.

## Backup and restore

Save backup creates a JSON file containing workout history and settings: language, theme, score display mode and pull-up parameters. The system file picker lets you save it locally or to cloud storage. Restore can merge the backup with current history or replace the current history. Older backup v1 files containing only history are still supported.

## Tips

Keep the camera steady and avoid strong backlight. Make sure shoulders, hips and at least part of the legs are visible. If automatic bar detection is unreliable, use Line. If repetitions are missed, first check framing and technique before changing thresholds. Change detector parameters gradually and use the reset icon to return to defaults.
